summary: In full screen AssistantShell shows the chat list as a left column (a drawer below 900 px) when the chat keeps several; historyPane={false} removes it, a node replaces it.
howTo: Nothing to do for the default: with modes including 'fullscreen' and a chat that keeps several conversations, full screen shows SessionSwitcher variant="list" in a 260 px column and names the open chat in the header. historyPane={false} keeps the header switcher instead; historyPane={<MyPane />} renders an own column. Labels history, showHistory, hideHistory (German ships); icon history.
